sensitivity: Exclude all flagged dates on the original session grid; never close gaps or recompute changes across removed dates
session_policy: Observed local session proxy: at least one class has eligible price. Dates absent both and both-carried rows are not assumed trading sessions. Independent calendar remains unavailable.
flag_policy: Large discount changes >5pp and adjacent-valid intervals >10 days from quality audit; carried code with positive volume; asymmetric source rows; weekdays absent both. Corporate split marker is context, not an exclusion flag. Top-ten display highlights are not automatic exclusions.
